content.title: Golden State Warriors vs Dallas Mavericks injury report: Who's playing, injured and questionable players, head-to-head records, team stats, and more (March 23, 2026)
content.text: Dallas Mavericks vs Golden State Warriors (Image via Getty)The Golden State Warriors and Dallas Mavericks face each other on March 23, 2026, with both teams still in the Western Conference picture. Golden State is trying to hold its place in the play-in zone, while Dallas is further down the standings after a season affected by injuries.This game is shaped more by who is available than by star matchups. Both sides are missing key players, which has forced changes in rotations and roles. The focus shifts to execution, pace, and how well each team uses the players it has.Golden State Warriors vs Dallas Mavericks injury report (March 23, 2026)Golden State Warriors injury report and expected rotationGolden State will be without several key names. Stephen Curry is out with knee soreness linked to patella-femoral pain and a bone bruise, and he is set for re-evaluation later in March. Al Horford is out with a calf strain, and Moses Moody continues to be sidelined with a wrist injury. Kristaps Porzingis is listed as day-to-day because of back issues and illness management, but he is not expected to play. Gary Payton II is also day-to-day with a knee problem.Quinten Post is expected to be available and should return to the rotation. With several absences, the team will lean on Draymond Green, and Brandin Podziemski. Other available players include Gui Santos, Will Richard, Nate Williams, and L.J. Cryer.Dallas Mavericks injury report and available playersDallas Mavericks vs Golden State Warriors. Image via: AP Dallas Mavericks remain short-handed. Kyrie Irving is out for the season with a torn ACL, and Dereck Lively II is also ruled out after foot surgery. Brandon Williams is still in concussion protocol and will not play.Caleb Martin, who had been listed as questionable with a bruised heel, is now expected to miss this game.The available group includes Khris Middleton, P.J. Washington, Max Christie, Marvin Bagley III, Naji Marshall, Cooper Flagg, Moussa Cisse, and Ryan Nembhard. These players have taken on most of the minutes recently.Golden State Warriors vs Dallas Mavericks season head-to-head trends and recent resultsThe Golden State Warriors lead the season series 2–1. In the last meeting on December 25, 2025, Golden State won 126–116 after building an early lead with a strong first quarter.In their wins, the Warriors have scored between 118 and 122 points and shot close to 50 percent from the field. Dallas has remained competitive in stretches but has had issues on defense during key periods of the game.Golden State Warriors vs Dallas Mavericks Team stats snapshot before March 24, 2026TeamRecord (W-L)Adj. Without a consistent rim protector, rebounding and limiting second chances will be important.Final outlook for March 23 Golden State Warriors vs Dallas Mavericks clashBoth teams are missing several players, so depth will matter.
